finding.observation: Four near-equivalent Architect packets routing the same Trigger-7 ACK-integrity repair to Trigger 4 were committed within roughly one minute by concurrent Architect sessions. Each packet has a distinct packet_id/nonce/route_id, so per-packet duplicate-nonce idempotency does not identify the semantic duplicate.
finding.failure_mode: The current protocol prevents duplicate processing of the same nonce but not duplicate creation of semantically equivalent packets by multiple persistent-Architect reentries. This can multiply ACK work/context, create redundant routing noise, and under weak workers can increase duplicate-build pressure even though packets themselves grant no mutation authority.

counterevidence_and_boundaries.why_this_is_not_yet_product_damage: The routed packets explicitly preserve normal Trigger-4 mutation authority and zero product/runtime/effect/training credit. One packet also tells the worker to review/verify rather than duplicate an equivalent repair already on main.
counterevidence_and_boundaries.what_is_proven: Cross-session semantic duplicate routing occurred on canonical main with different packet identities.
counterevidence_and_boundaries.what_is_not_proven: No evidence yet shows that a worker performed duplicate canonical mutation or duplicate runtime dispatch because of these packets.

recommended_repair.preferred_shape: Add an explicit deterministic coordination_intent_id (or equivalent semantic-boundary key) to packet creation, derived from a caller-supplied stable objective/boundary identity rather than free-text similarity. Before committing a new pending packet, refresh main and perform create-only/CAS ownership on that intent key or detect an unexpired equivalent intent and reuse/supersede it. Keep packet nonce/route identity for delivery idempotency; intent identity is a separate creation-dedup fence, not a second truth or delivery state machine.
minimum_regressions: two concurrent creators with same coordination_intent_id yield one active intent owner and one reuse/defer result
different wording with same explicit intent id cannot create parallel active repair packets
different intent ids remain independently routable
expired/terminal intent can be superseded without rewriting immutable packet history
creation dedup failure cannot grant mutation/runtime/effect/credit authority
recommended_repair.anti_pattern: Do not use embedding similarity or LLM semantic judgment as the authoritative dedup gate; the key must be explicit and deterministic.

next_exact_action: Consume only one existing ACK-integrity repair packet as the build objective, ACK/reject the others without duplicate mutation, then add a deterministic cross-session coordination-intent creation fence and test it under concurrent packet creation.
